• Experience with SAP MM and SAP WM (localization or project background aligned to Colombia or Chile).
  • Colombia or Chile localization experience needed.
  • Based out of any South American country.
  • Ability to support the customer from 9:00 AM CST to 5:00 PM CST.
  • Spanish and English fluency (able to communicate clearly with stakeholders in both languages).
  • Willingness to travel to Colombia or Chile based on customer request.
At Crest IT Resources LLC, we help mid-market and enterprise organizations scale their technology teams with pre-vetted, interview-ready engineers through IT consulting and staff augmentation. For this engagement, we need SAP MM/WM resources based in South America who can support a customer during North/Central time. You will be part of a timezone-aligned delivery effort, providing enterprise-ready support to ensure day-to-day SAP MM/WM operations run smoothly for the business stakeholders.
  • Support the customer’s SAP MM/WM needs during the required coverage window: 9:00 AM CST to 5:00 PM CST.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring requirements and updates are understood in both Spanish and English.
  • Handle customer requests related to SAP MM/WM work as directed by the engagement scope.
  • Follow the client’s process for coordination, issue tracking, and resolution.
  • When requested, travel to Colombia or Chile to support delivery activities.
  • Previous customer-facing experience supporting SAP MM/WM users and processes.
  • Experience working in Colombia or Chile delivery environments (local business processes, terminology, and practical configuration knowledge).
  • Comfort working in a timezone-aligned support model and coordinating across teams during the CST window.
  • Adaptability for travel-based support when required by the customer.
We will tailor the work setup to the client needs within Colombia or Chile localization. You will support the customer from 9:00 AM CST to 5:00 PM CST, with Spanish and English communication required. If the customer requests it, travel to Colombia or Chile may be needed as part of the engagement.
